title: Pastor Freddy Portales:
title_short: Adopt-A-Block · Freddy · My Students Were in the Line
headline: A pastor who teaches English on Mondays met three of his own students in the Saturday grocery line. Groceries are the first door. People come back on Sunday and families change.
story: Freddy Portales runs the Spanish ministry at the Dream Center in Oak Cliff and teaches English classes on Mondays. On 10 Oct three or four of his students came through the grocery line, and he tested their English on the spot. The physical need opens the door to the rest. Series: Faces of the Dream Center.

Loops: L1 “What students? Why are they in a grocery line?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:11 (he teaches English on Mondays). L2 “What happens after the groceries?” opens 0:00 and closes in the button. Stakes: a Spanish-speaking neighborhood learning a new language; without bilingual volunteers the door stays shut.
